## CRM Information

- **Name**: [e.g., HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce]
- **Website**: [CRM website URL]
- **API Documentation**: [Link to API docs]

## Use Case

Why do you need this CRM integration? How many people would benefit from it?

## API Capabilities

Does the CRM API support:

- [ ] Listing/searching meetings or activities by date/time
- [ ] Creating notes/comments
- [ ] Linking notes to people/contacts
- [ ] Linking notes to companies/organizations
- [ ] Authentication (API key, OAuth, etc.)

## API Key Availability

- [ ] I have access to the CRM API (trial or paid account)
- [ ] I can test the integration
- [ ] I'm willing to share API documentation or test cases

## Implementation Notes

Any specific API quirks, rate limits, or authentication details we should know about?

## Would You Like to Contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I can implement this integration
- [ ] Yes, I can test once implemented
- [ ] No, just requesting
